channel.title: Peninsula Insider
channel.description: Editorial coverage of the Mornington Peninsula - eat, stay, do, wine, and the weekend curated.

item.title: St Andrews Beach Brewery, the Bushrangers Bay Track, and the Breast Foot Forward Walk
item.description: A Sunday roast at the old stables brewery in Fingal, the Bushrangers Bay coastal loop in full spring flower, and a community walk from Safety Beach to Martha Cove on Saturday.

item.title: Jackalope in spring, Cape Woolamai from the ridge, and live wrestling for a good cause
item.description: Doot Doot Doot's vineyard dining in Merricks North, the Cape Woolamai ridge walk at peak wattle, and Dominion Wrestling's charity bout at Commonfolk on Friday night.

item.title: Avani Syrah in Red Hill South, the Bushrangers Bay clifftop loop, and Peppers Moonah Links live music this Saturday
item.description: Avani Wines' skin-contact whites and Syrah at Red Hill South, Bushrangers Bay coastal loop in peak spring flower, and Acoustic Saturdays at Peppers Moonah Links from 5pm this Saturday.

item.title: Many Little in spring, the Mornington Peninsula Rail Trail, and Acoustic Saturdays at Peppers Moonah Links
item.description: Sri Lankan-inflected fine dining at Polperro, the Rail Trail in full wildflower season, and live music on the lawn at Fingal this Saturday from 5pm.

item.title: Bass & Flinders gin school, Cape Schanck boardwalk in spring, and the Rye Foreshore Market
item.description: Blend your own gin at Bass & Flinders in Dromana, visit the Cape Schanck coastal viewpoints, and browse the Rye Foreshore Market on a confirmed market day.

item.title: The Bay Hotel's vault room, Balnarring's wildflower verge walk, and NWOP at MPRG
item.description: The Bay Hotel Mornington's vault dining room for a group occasion, the Balnarring to Coolart Wetlands trail in peak spring flower, and the National Works on Paper 2026 at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery before November.

item.title: Moke Dining in Flinders, the Bushrangers Bay boardwalk, and the Hill & Ridge Market
item.description: Michael Cole's five-course set menu in Flinders, the Bushrangers Bay boardwalk track at spring peak, and the Hill & Ridge Community Market at Red Hill Recreation Reserve on Saturday.

item.title: Red Hill Brewery's hop garden, the spring wildflower window on Arthurs Seat, and Peninsula Hot Springs Sunday Sessions
item.description: Red Hill Brewery pours from its own estate hop garden, Arthurs Seat's Seawinds Garden hits peak spring bloom, and Peninsula Hot Springs launches its Sunday Sessions series in Fingal.

item.title: Rye Hotel's beer garden, the Cape Schanck clifftop, and National Works on Paper at MPRG
item.description: A sprawling foreshore pub hits its spring stride, Cape Schanck's clifftop track opens up in the wildflower window, and Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery's National Works on Paper runs until 22 November.

item.description: Foxeys Hangout's biodynamic sparkling flight in the spring sun, the Bushrangers Bay cliff path at its wildflower peak, and Arj Barker live at Barlow on Wednesday night.

item.title: One More Hour: Three After-Five Peninsula Plans
item.description: Daylight saving begins on 4 October. Choose the evening by the time, weather and energy you actually have, then keep one useful fallback.

item.title: Dromana Hotel deck, wildflower heathland at Greens Bush, and the Dromana Community Market
item.description: The Dromana Hotel's bay-view deck in first-spring warmth, the spider orchids peaking along Greens Bush, and Saturday's Dromana Community Market before the crowds.

item.title: Main Ridge Dairy, Seawinds Gardens, and Pt. Leo's sculpture park
item.description: Build a spring day around Main Ridge Dairy's goat cheeses, the short paths at Seawinds Gardens, and sculpture at Pt. Leo Estate.

item.description: Jetty Road Brewery's rotating spring taps in Dromana, the heathland wildflower bloom along the Coolart Wetlands boardwalk, and National Works on Paper 2026 at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery before November.

item.title: Spring school holidays on the Peninsula

item.title: A Practical Spring Visit to National Works on Paper
item.description: The confirmed dates, regular opening hours and location for a straightforward gallery visit in Mornington.
